set.body: Owner: ScalaFIM integration across its legacy active branch and canonical main. CORRECTION to initial diagnosis: canonical image value/frame migration was already implemented in a3c232055b2514865ec286e35d99ff113c611e1c and unified further through main10d1466. Reuse that architecture; do not implement compatibility aliases, old NeuroSpace/NeuroVol wrappers, raw affine equality, or application-local semantic substitutes. Earlier 84 compile errors and 35/33 test failures describe an obsolete seven-file compatibility experiment against the legacy branch, not an absent provider migration. Current bounded candidate: /private/tmp/scalafim-output-canonical-1 at10d1466 plus provider-owned dimension refinement and public incremental NIfTI bridge; /private/tmp/image4s-output-canonical-1 at18ffdce plus the verified writer/refinement. Acceptance: canonical image JVM/JS owner and coordinate tests, direct dataset/fit consumers, and deliberate forward-port of recent selected-estimate/response-basis changes from the active legacy branch without overwriting peers. App pins remain separately owned. The exact reframe4s pin53a5c3c is locally present but not available to a fresh remote clone; an exact local archive permits local qualification only. The broad integration prerequisite remains open until recent scientific consumers and dependency admission are reconciled.
set.title: Reconcile selected-estimate work with the existing canonical image architecture
